source.geometryPrecision: Source zoom14 vector-tile geometry, local coordinates rounded to 0.1 m; no invented footprint or street.
source.heightPolicy: OpenMapTiles render_height. Default5m+base0 is conservatively unknown; all heights remain provider-derived, not survey-verified.
source.projection: WGS84 ellipsoid local east/south linear metres, origin43.2962N5.3734E
source.corePolicy: Any building overlapping ±550m core excluded. Roads, water and ground polygons clipped outside core; original core data unchanged.
source.chunkPolicy: Buildings owned by centroid chunk and retain full footprint/bounds. Other geometry clipped to512m cells. Load neighbouring cells for cross-boundary buildings.
source.encoding: Lossless0.1m delta zigzag varints, string table, independently lazy-decoded512m chunks

heightEnrichment.name: IGN BD TOPO
heightEnrichment.definition: Height from lowest ground to highest gutter, not roof ridge. Source field hauteur; no derived or invented heights.
heightEnrichment.matchPolicy: Unknown OSM heights only. OSM intersection coverage>=0.80 and intersection/union>=0.60. Competing footprint with>=20% OSM coverage and height difference>2m rejected. Height must exceed retained OSM minHeight.
heightEnrichment.uncertainty: Source precision_altimetrique retained in metres; -1 means unspecified. Ground altitude retained as metadata only (-9999 unknown). Acquisition-method estimates/forced values rejected. Each matched footprint retains IGN cleabs reference. Geometry remains original OSM.
